description: Guards the autonomy posture of the passive learning-capture feature (ADR 0002 addendum, v0.3.7). learn-capture.sh is a default-OFF, advisory-only computational-FB sensor: it journals + queues candidates out-of-repo, but must NEVER emit a permissionDecision (it does not gate SessionEnd) and confidence must NEVER appear in a gating comparison (it is an ordering signal only — ECC's model-as-gate is what kbg rejects). These are static source assertions, independent of any session state. If any regresses, the capture half has drifted toward the ECC apply half the addendum forecloses.

evals.task: hooks/sensors.json must register learn-capture AND learn-drain-nudge, both with fallback_role=computational-FB and enabled=true (so the staleness grid and audit #47 classify them as enforcement-class computational sensors, not inferential LLM judges).

context.command: python3 -c "import json; s={x['name']:x for x in json.load(open('hooks/sensors.json'))['sensors']}; lc=s.get('learn-capture',{}); dn=s.get('learn-drain-nudge',{}); print('lc_role='+str(lc.get('fallback_role'))); print('dn_role='+str(dn.get('fallback_role'))); print('lc_enabled='+str(lc.get('enabled'))); print('both_present='+str('learn-capture' in s and 'learn-drain-nudge' in s))"

evals.task: After stripping full-line comments, hooks/session/learn-capture.sh must contain ZERO references to permissionDecision / hook_decision / kbg_permission_decision — the capture sensor journals and queues, it never gates SessionEnd.

context.command: python3 -c "import re; lines=[l for l in open('hooks/session/learn-capture.sh') if not re.match(r'\\s*#', l)]; body=''.join(lines); n=len(re.findall(r'permissionDecision|hook_decision|kbg_permission_decision', body)); print('gate_refs='+str(n))"

evals.task: Neither hooks/session/learn-capture.sh nor skills/learn/SKILL.md may compare a confidence value against a threshold to trigger an action (e.g. 'confidence >= 0.7'). Confidence is an ORDERING signal only — this is the exact line that keeps the feature out of ECC's model-as-gate.

context.command:
python3 -c "
import re
m = 0
for f in ['hooks/session/learn-capture.sh', 'skills/learn/SKILL.md']:
    body = ''.join(l for l in open(f) if not re.match(r'\\s*#', l))
    m += len(re.findall(r'confidence *(>=|>|-ge|-gt) *0\\.[0-9]', body))
print('confidence_gates=' + str(m))
"

evals.task: harness-audit check #47 must exist and CRIT-guard both legs (no permissionDecision in the capture hook; no confidence gate in the hook or skills/learn/SKILL.md).

context.command: python3 -c "src=open('skills/harness-audit/scripts/audit.sh').read(); print('has_47='+str('# 47.' in src)); print('guards_lc='+str('learn-capture.sh' in src and 'confidence *' in src))"
